bench.rule: S032 §3 -- complete-session timing is not a promotion benchmark

claim_boundary: This is a non-bitwise physical candidate: routes and consecutive source-terminal tokens passed, but the exact per-layer state-hash contract was intentionally withheld because its reduction order differs. It cannot replace the exact resident body or support capability, EBPW, qualified TPS, or promotion claims without a separately earned tolerance/capability contract.

active_bytes_accounting.claim_boundary: Resident immutable weights and persistent state are measured from the owning banks. Selected-expert geometry and hardware cache/fetch traffic are separate quantities; this receipt does not observe hardware cache traffic or claim a physical bytes-fetched-per-token value.

selected_expert_geometry.claim_boundary: This is a geometry bound for selected routed-expert rows, not a DRAM/cache counter or a claim that the same bytes are fetched from physical memory on every token.
selected_expert_geometry.measurement: logical selected routed-expert row geometry; selected rows are already resident in compact device banks

clean_replay.claim_boundary: This is a bounded known-sequence replay over a body that previously passed exact state/route/token checks. It is not capability-qualified sustained decode TPS, future-route coverage, EBPW, or promotion evidence.
clean_replay.gpu_timing_attribution: aggregate: the command-buffer GPU interval covers all linear and full-attention banks; token wall and aggregate GPU are authoritative, per-species GPU/wall attribution is withheld
clean_replay.scheduler: all 48 resident banks are encoded in layer order into one queue-ordered command buffer per token, followed by one fence
clean_replay.state_reset: full-attention KV buffers explicitly zeroed before every replay; linear recurrent state reset at token zero
clean_replay.timed_window: retained device-only banks; no source tensor reads, host activation snapshots, route readback/comparison, or terminal execution

token_time_ledger.species_timing: aggregate: one whole-token command buffer contains all banks, so per-species wall/GPU intervals are intentionally not attributed

execution.cross_species_activation_handoff: device buffers; host snapshots are diagnostic-only and never feed a later layer

full_attention_compact_bank_residency.claim_boundary: All exact teacher-bound compact full-attention banks retain device-only weights and persistent KV state while the token-major 48-layer body executes. This control still includes per-layer snapshots and route checks, so it is not a clean warmed TPS measurement.

invocation_admission.claim_boundary: The caller asserted that a wrapper performed its external source/lane checks before launch. Native code does not authenticate that assertion, grant a lease, or establish source-independent execution.

linear_compact_bank_residency.claim_boundary: All exact teacher-bound compact linear banks remain device-only through the accepted token sequence as part of the 48-layer token-major owner. This is a correctness control with per-layer diagnostics, not a clean warmed TPS measurement.

native_lane_preflight.observation: point-in-time ps preflight only; it is neither a lock, a lease, nor a timing/exclusivity witness

execution.per_layer_state_hash_contract: withheld for candidate reduction-order experiment; exact routes and source-terminal token checks remain enforced
execution.reference_contract: each caller-supplied continuation token is independently compared with the terminal argmax of its preceding exact 48-layer state
execution.state_reset_scope: linear species reset only before session token zero; full-attention KV buffers allocated once per layer and indexed by the advancing token position

token_major_resident_banks.claim_boundary: Every immutable compact bank is owned by one token-major native body until after the terminal checks. The retained teacher route union is bounded to the recorded sequence, and per-layer diagnostics remain enabled; no warm TPS, future-route coverage, EBPW, capability, or resident-promotion claim follows.

next: Use this exact resident body to construct a separate clean repeated timing path that removes per-layer host snapshots, route comparisons, and terminal calls from the timed loop while retaining source, state, dispatch, and bytes/token census.

physical_configuration.claim_boundary: This records selected opt-in physical kernels for reproducibility. A true flag is not a qualification or promotion claim; the receipt contract remains authoritative.

ple_pre_layer_state_bank.claim_boundary: Raw F32 snapshots are session diagnostics only. They are not a compact representation, independent source PLE parity, direct PLE execution, complete EBPW, capability, or TPS evidence.
